private Map<String, Interval> constrain(RVal e, Interval R, Map<String, Interval> env) {
  if (R == null) return null;
  if (e instanceof RVal.IntConst ic) {
     BigInteger v = ic.v();
     if (contains(R, v)) return Map.of();
     else return null;
  }
  if (e instanceof LVal.Local loc) {
     Interval cur = env.getOrDefault(loc.name(), Interval.TOP);
     Interval c = Interval.intersect(cur, R);
     if (c == null) return null;
     return Map.of(loc.name(), c);
  }
  if (e instanceof LVal.StaticField sf) {
     Interval c = staticInterval(sf);
     if (c == null) return Map.of(); // unknown static, no constraint
     if (Interval.disjoint(c, R)) return null;
     return Map.of();
  }
  if (e instanceof RVal.Binop b) {
     if (isComparison(b.op())) {
        Interval eval = eval(e, env);
        if (eval == null) return null;
        if (Interval.disjoint(eval, R)) return null;
        boolean mayTrue = contains(R, BigInteger.ONE);
        boolean mayFalse = contains(R, BigInteger.ZERO);
        if (!mayTrue && !mayFalse) return null;
        if (mayTrue && !mayFalse) {
           Map<String,Interval> newEnv = applyRelation(env, b.l(), b.op(), b.r(), true);
           if (newEnv == null) return null;
           return diffConstraints(env, newEnv);
        } else if (!mayTrue && mayFalse) {
           Map<String,Interval> newEnv = applyRelation(env, b.l(), b.op(), b.r(), false);
           if (newEnv == null) return null;
           return diffConstraints(env, newEnv);
        } else {
           return Map.of();
        }
     } else {
        // arithmetic
        Interval le = eval(b.l(), env);
        Interval re = eval(b.r(), env);
        if (le == null || re == null) return null;
        Interval whole = eval(e, env);
        if (whole == null || Interval.disjoint(whole, R)) return null;
        Interval lc, rc;
        switch (b.op()) {
          case Add -> {
             lc = Interval.minus(R, re);
             rc = Interval.minus(R, le);
          }
          case Sub -> {
             // left - right = R
             lc = Interval.plus(R, re); // R + right
             rc = Interval.minus(le, R); // left - R
          }
          case Mult -> {
             lc = multOperandInterval(R, re);
             rc = multOperandInterval(R, le);
             if (lc == null || rc == null) return null;
          }
          default -> { return Map.of(); } // shouldn't
        }
        if (lc == null || rc == null) return null;
        // Intersect operand constraints with current eval? constrain subexpr will intersect with env.
        Map<String,Interval> res = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String,Interval> leftC = constrain(b.l(), lc, env);
        if (leftC == null) return null;
        merge(res, leftC);
        Map<String,Interval> rightC = constrain(b.r(), rc, env);
        if (rightC == null) return null;
        merge(res, rightC);
        return res;
     }
  }
  return Map.of();
}
